from fractions import Fraction as F
pi=F(22,7);th=pi/3
r=F(64,3)/(2+th)
assert r==7
v=r*r*th/2
opts=[F(47,3),F(85,3),F(68,3),F(77,3)]
assert v==opts[3]
for i in range(3): assert v!=opts[i]

import sympy as sp
a=sp.symbols('a',positive=True)
v=sp.sqrt(sp.simplify(8*a**2*18/a**4))
opts=[12/a**2,12*a**2,12/a,12*a]
assert sp.simplify(v-opts[2])==0
for i in (0,1,3): assert sp.simplify(v-opts[i])!=0

from fractions import Fraction as F
t=(F(5,4)*(-2)-4)/(7-F(5,4)*9)
assert (7*t+4)/(9*t-2)==F(5,4)
v=(t*t+5)/(t*t-5)
opts=[F(-769,2121),F(769,2121),F(2121,769),F(-2121,769)]
assert v==opts[3]
for i in range(3): assert v!=opts[i]

import math
A=math.radians(37)
s,c=math.sin(A),math.cos(A)
v=s/(1+c)
opts=[(1+s)/c,(1-s)/c,(1+c)/s,(1-c)/s]
assert abs(v-opts[3])<1e-9
for i in range(3): assert abs(v-opts[i])>1e-6

from fractions import Fraction as F
s=F(3,11)
assert (1+s)/(1-s)==F(7,4)
v=1/s
opts=[F(1,3),F(1,11),F(11,3),F(3,11)]
assert v==opts[2]
for i in (0,1,3): assert v!=opts[i]
